habitat: Parties of six to ten favour granite koppies, riverine forest, wooded valleys and thornveld, generally in rocky situations and seldom far from water.
summary: A common, near-endemic resident. Dark brown above with black streaking. The colour key says speckled black and white below. The description says entirely black-and-white-barred underparts, bolder than Red-billed Spurfowl, with red legs and a red bill with a yellow base. The call is a harsh kwali, KWALI, kwali, and a raucous cackle when alarmed. The Kemp paper name Natal Francolin and the code RB were left unchanged.

research.note: Newman calls it a common near-endemic resident, so status is resident and all twelve months are listed. The underparts are speckled in the colour key and barred in the description, which is why this needs review. Red-billed Spurfowl is the comparison Newman names and is not in this list. Population figures, the Kemp paper name Natal Francolin and the code RB were left unchanged.
